}}'''Furen Alharra''' is [[Warder]] to [[Seonid Traighan]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Furen Alharra}}

== Appearance ==
He has curly black hair streaked with gray. He is very dark, tall, and lean with dark eyes.

== History ==
He is [[Tairen]].

== Activities ==
He traveled with Seonid to [[Ghealdan]]. He was furious with the way the [[Aiel]] [[Wise Ones]] treated Seonid{{ref/book|10|27}} and together with [[Teryl Wynter]] offered to take punishment in place of Seonid.{{ref/book|8|9}}

When [[Faile Bashere]] was captured by the [[Shaido]] Aiel, he traveled with [[Elyas Machera]] to find her tracks.{{ref/book|9|6}}

He accompanied [[Perrin Aybara]] and Seonid to [[So Habor]], where he stuck close to her when Seonid and the residents claimed to have seen ghosts.{{ref/book|10|26}}

He went through the aqueduct to enter the town of [[Malden]] before Perrin began his attack.{{ref/book|11|26}}
